thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're cutting over the new price sheet cohort tomorrow 17:00 PT. Need final list of grandfathering exceptions + confirmation of invoice timing. cc @sana @leo

leo: Uploaded the cohort CSV to Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c. One question — several legacy customers have a billing anchor on the 1st of the month. Do we preserve their billing cycle or align to the new cohort start? Also flagging ~6 accounts that will need manual credits.

sana: I think we should honor existing billing anchors for any customer flagged 'legal-grandfather' in the last quarter. I'll pull and attach the list in a minute. We also need a short runbook for mid-month cutover (rollback steps + who to page).

alex: Platform can gate the rollout behind a feature flag per-account, but I need explicit mapping from new price-tier to model-id/route. FYI switching tiers will invalidate some KV cache keys — expect a temporary 5-10% perf blip for affected requests.

rachel: From product: A/B assignment is 10% canary / 40% new pricing / 50% holdback. Is the revenue recognition lag for the canary acceptable? CS asked for outreach to top-20 accounts that might be affected.

tom: I can handle customer outreach. Please send the grandfather exceptions CSV by 12:00 PT so I can triage and schedule calls.

billing-bot: Generated preview invoices for cohort sample (10 accounts). Preview link: https://invoices.preview/internal/1800123456. Note: credits applied where 'legacy_credit' flag exists.

maya: I've sent the exceptions list via secure 1:1 to finance leads. Proposed rules: (1) Any account with contract_end > 2025-01-01 gets full grandfathering. (2) Manual exceptions require CFO sign-off. Anyone opposed?

sana: SQL we used to surface candidates (run on analytics):
```sql
SELECT account_id, billing_anchor, contract_end, flagged_legacy
FROM accounts
WHERE flagged_legacy = true
  AND last_30d_usage > 0;
```
Run this and dump CSV to drive, then we'll reconcile with legal flags.

leo: I'll run that query at 10:30 PT and post the cleaned CSV. One more ops caveat: invoicing batch runs at 02:00 UTC. Cutover must be done before that batch window or we'll risk double invoicing.

maya: Good catch. Let's target cutover at 16:00 PT to leave a buffer before 02:00 UTC batch. If anything looks off we'll delay to the next day. @alex can you produce a rollback script and quick smoke tests?

alex: Yep — I'll add a rollback endpoint + smoke test that posts to /billing/preview and asserts token usage delta and invoice preview consistency. Will push script and smoke test by EOD.

sana: Confirmed — I'll coordinate with Tom for comms and with Leo for the CSV. Final CSV by 12:00 PT.

maya: Thanks everyone. If anything urgent pops up ping me directly. :pray:
